_about: Ground truth for every non-obvious rule in Lifeline. Harness-only: agents can never read this file. `marker` is a regex for the fact's single source of truth; it appears in exactly one Lifeline file at the task start commit. `tasks` maps each task to the files that depend on the fact (ops tasks point at scripts/). `stale` names the Lifeline commit that still holds the old (wrong) version (`old_commit`, matched by `old_marker`) and the commit that changed it (`change_commit`).

F1.truth: Members under age 2 count as 0.5 people for rations.
F1.wrong: Every member counts as 1 person, whatever their age.

F2.truth: Kits = household size divided by 2 (one kit feeds exactly 2 people), rounded down with math.floor.
F2.wrong: Kits are rounded up with math.ceil.

F3.truth: Lots are issued FEFO: the lot that expires first is used first.
F3.wrong: Lots are issued FIFO: the lot that arrived first is used first.
F3.note: No kept task uses F3 (T07 was dropped when the task set was cut to 8). It stays in Lifeline as realistic code.

F4.truth: Warehouse IDs are WH-<region code>-<2 digits>, e.g. WH-HGL-07.
F4.wrong: Warehouse IDs are WH followed by digits, e.g. WH07.

F5.truth: Household IDs are HH- plus 4 digits plus a weighted mod-11 check digit: weights 5, 4, 3, 2; check = (11 - sum mod 11) mod 11; a result of 10 is never issued.
F5.wrong: Household IDs are HH- plus any 5 digits; there is no check digit.

seed_exceptions.note: Legacy household IDs entered before T01's validation existed. They fail the check digit and appear only in the T09 duplicate pairs (one per pair).

F7.truth: A household is eligible with a score of 60 or more, or 45 or more if a member is pregnant.
F7.wrong: A household is eligible with a score of 50 or more; pregnancy does not change the cutoff.

F8.truth: Road codes: A = open, R = restricted to light vehicles (vans), X = closed.
F8.wrong: Road codes: A = open, R = closed, X = closed.

F9.truth: Duplicate households match on the Soundex code of the head's name plus the head's birth year.
F9.wrong: Duplicate households match only when the head's name is spelled exactly the same.

F10.truth: SMS are sent with queue_sms(household_id, template_id, params) using an approved template; max 140 characters.
F10.wrong: SMS are sent with send_sms(phone, text) as free text; max 160 characters.

F11.truth: Every payment carries the idempotency key "{household_id}:{cycle}".
F11.wrong: Payments need no idempotency key (or the key is just the household ID).

F12.truth: Every payment must be recorded with audit.record("payment", actor, ref=payment.id).
F12.wrong: Audit logging is optional; payments do not need an audit entry.
F12.marker: RULE: every payment must be recorded here

F13.truth: Cold regions are marked `climate: cold` in config/regions.yaml.
F13.wrong: Cold regions are marked `cold: true` in config/regions.yaml.

F14.truth: reserve_stock(warehouse_id, sku, qty, hold_hours), in that order; hold_hours is required.
F14.wrong: reserve_stock(sku, warehouse_id, qty), with no hold_hours.
